description: How long a dev's rugs took: the measured median time from first seen to the pull, with p25 and N -- a record, not a prediction. Pass creator (a wallet) or ca (a coin; its dev is looked up) for that dev's own median pull, the same number and source as the coin card's "median pull" line, with N rugged with a pull time and N launched. Under 5 timed pulls the percentiles are null and enough_data is false -- say "not enough timed pulls to state a time" rather than quoting a number. Pass nothing (or chain / window) for the chain and launchpad table: median, p25, p75 and N per window, null under 30. N always travels in the answer.

ca.description: a Solana coin mint; answers for the dev who launched it, counted to its launch like the card

creator.description: a dev wallet (Solana base58, or 0x on Robinhood Chain with chain rh)

window.description: table only: the resolution window; defaults to 24h

name: groundtruth_time_to_rug
